Initial commit
Credit where credit is due

Client/Server - Fixed login map draw, item prototype.

Maps now have a list of items. These can block movement and have animations for now.

Server - SQL account handling

Server now handles accounts via SQL. Still needs character handling.
Fixed character switching while entering text in new character screen.

Client - Patcher single-file update when entering maps.

Now the client's patcher will update maps individually when entering them, instead of updating them all at once on login.
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/master'

Players movement block, item prototype

(Untested) Other players now block movement.
Created item prototype class. Unused for now.
Added client_setposition method for server for easier change of clients' positions.
Server - players folder
Client - Fixed chatlog line character width calculation

Client - Tickers' framerate consideration

Client now takes framerate into consideration when processing tickers such as character/tile animation, move/attack speed, etc. This fixes low framerate clients not being able to send pings frequently enough, thus losing the connection.
Client - Connection error catching

Chat scrolling

You can now scroll through the chat-log using the PgUP and PgDOWN keys.

Chat - /msg and /who commands

Added two chat commands. "/msg <player name> <message>" will send a message privately to another player. "/who" will display all currently online players.
Server-side messages sent to players individually can now be colored.

GUI - Player name

Added player name to GUI.

GUI System, chat

Implemented GUI System for client. For now draws some basic stats such as health, xp, attack, etc.
Implemented Chatlog system, local messages will now be logged here.
Multiplayer chat. Press enter to send a message. Default is local chat, where only nearby players in the same map will hear. Use the /g command to talk globally.

Server - No password login fix

Fixed bug where any account could log-in if the entered password was empty.

Server/Client - Improved client attribute setting, Player class

Server can now change multiple client-side attributes with a single "setstat_pl" message.
Server-side clients have a set of attributes that are shared to the client, and are also saved into the character file.
New Player class for player characters, inherited from Entity. For now handles player xp/level.
Client - Ping timeout fix.

Client - Moved display init outside gamesystem

Pygame display is now initialized directly from the client.py file.
Used convert_alpha in tile wallshadows sprite.

Client - BFS Illumination

Client now uses Breadth First Search algorithm for tile illumination (should be more efficient with larger amounts of light sources).
Used convert_alpha on menu background to improve menu performance.
Explored but non-visible tiles now use default map light level.
Ping timeout fix.
Client game now dies on server disconnection

Editor - Add flags mode

Editor now has an 'Add flags' mode (ALT + F), where the entered flags will be added to the current flags list for newly placed tiles.

Client - Slightly optimized illumination

Last commit's optimization was done on the FoV system, this one is the proper illumination system.

Client - Slightly optimized illumination.

Illumination system slightly optimized. Now the function that runs the algorithm can receive an x_min/x_max, y_min/y_max rectangle, which limits the calculation area.
Emptied options file.

Client - Screen system refactor

All menu screens are now inherited from a ScreenMenu class, which contains most of the necessary features for a menu screen, vastly reducing code needed.

Client - Input saving

Client now remembers some relevant fields when re-loaded, such as name of last played character and account.

Inter-player illumination

Other players now generate light, based on their 'light' stat, and update accordingly when they move (and are visible).
Server now holds client's character position as x and y ints (used to be pygame Vector2, which used floats).

Client stat updating, disconnection crash fix

Server can now update a client's attribute (eg. player character) and inform all other clients of this change.
Fixed server crash when a client disconnected.
Other player characters are now drawn in vis_tiles, applying the illumination overlay from tiles to players as well.
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/master'

Screens system/Character and account creation.

Client:
    -Implemented a screens system for multiple screen handling. Currently features a menu screen with options to create/continue character and create account. Main game logic passed to a separate game screen.
    -You must now create an account to play. Each account can have multiple characters linked to it.
Server:
    -Now stores characters in a 'players' folder, and accounts/account links in the data folder.

Proper Readme update

Readable readme.
Readme update.

Client - Entities.

Class player renamed to entity for future inheritance to monsters/players.
Fixed indoor tiles default light level.

Client - Illumination change.

Tiles now draw a dark box over them to simulate illumination instead of changing their alpha value, making dark foreground tiles look better.

Client - Animated tiles.

Water, deep water and lava tiles are now properly animated.

Client - Smoother light transitions.

Light transition between tiles is now smoother.

Client/Editor - Illumination system.

Rough implementation of a dynamic lighting system. Player now has a light level to generate around him as well as a sight range stat that determines tile visibility range.
Tiles with the 'light' flag can now emit light around them.
Maps files now store a variable (after x/y size) that determines default light level for that map. Usually 16 for outdoor maps and 3 for underground/indoor maps.

Editor - Faster map drawing; Client fix.

Editor map drawing system optimized.
Fixed Client not updating entity surface size to match map size.

Client - Inter-entity visibility.

Players can now only see other players/entities when these are standing over visible tiles, ie. they are in line of sight.

Client - Faster player drawing.

Entity drawing system improved, now faster.
Early attempt at player visibility.

Client - Fixed player drawing.

Fixed bug where player animations would remain drawn. Game is somewhat slower though, since it needs to copy the map surface every frame (please find a better solution...)

Client - Player list is now a dictionary.

Client-side player list is now handled as a dictionary. Its keys are each player's ID, associated to its player object.

Client/Editor fixes/additions.

Editor:
-Fixed foreground deletion crash.
Client:
-Vastly optimized drawing system. Now tiles are only drawn once when an update is needed, instead of every frame.
-Fixed foreground tiles being invisible if tile below them was flagged as a wall.

Client - Wall shadows.

Wall tiles now have a small shadow around them.

Client - Pre-explored tiles grayscaled.

Pre-explored tiles are now grayscaled(and darkened).

Client - Visibility, display pre-explored tiles.

Tiles seen by player that go out of sight are now "remembered"(remain in map at lower opacity). This is reset when reloading the map.

Client - Rough tile visibility system.

Implemented a visibility system where the player can only see tiles in line of sight.

Client - 32x32 character sets.

Changed client's old 16x16 characters to new 32x32 sets.

Client - New tile drawing system.

Drawing system has been changed to improve performance when playing on large maps.

Editor - New tile drawing system.

Drawing system has been changed to improve performance when working on large maps.

Client - 32x32 tileset.

32x32 tileset change for client.
Also separated 'Tile' object into its own file.

Editor - Foreground sprite removal fix, 32x32 tileset.

Fixed foreground sprite not getting removed on right-click.
Now uses new 32x32 tileset (changed from 16x16).
Separated 'Tile' class into its own file.

Editor - Flag setter and selected tile info display.

Added tile flag setter via Shift+F.
Mousing over a tile now displays its x/y coords and flags.

Editor - fixed list as default parameter in Tile object.

UDP networking and Maps

Rough implementation of maps. Each map has a client list server-side.

Mastermind networking lib

Struct update
